options.text: The pin is made of a magnetic material; the eraser is not.
The eraser is made of a magnetic material; the pin is not.
Both are magnetic because Nidhi used a bar magnet near them.
Both are non-magnetic because only one object moved.

stem:
Nidhi brings a bar magnet near a steel safety pin and near a rubber eraser. The pin is attracted to the magnet. The eraser is not.

Which conclusion is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: A magnet attracts magnetic materials. The steel pin is attracted, so it is magnetic. The rubber eraser is not attracted, so it is non-magnetic.
